nodes.description: Public provenance hash string set by the owner, used for NFT metadata verification.
Public random offset index used to shuffle token metadata; once set it cannot be changed.
Block number recorded when the collection sold out, used as randomness source for offSetIndex.
Constant payout address 1 (Artist).
Constant payout address 2 (Community lead).
Constant payout address 3 (Dev).
Constant payout address 4 (Community wallet).
Constant maximum number of tokens mintable (3333).
Constant public sale purchase limit per transaction (5).
Constant whitelist purchase limit per wallet (3).
Constant public mint price (0.05 ether).
Constant whitelist mint price (0.03 ether).
Sale state controller: 0 closed, 1 whitelist, 2 public; gates mintToken behaviour.
Base metadata URI returned by _baseURI.
Constant maximum number of whitelist members (555).
Running count of whitelisted members, incremented by addToWhiteList.
Mapping of address to whiteListStruct tracking whitelist existence and amount purchased.
Counters.Counter used to derive the next token id for minting.
onlyOwner function that stores the provenance hash.
onlyOwner function that sets the base metadata URI.
Internal view override returning the stored BaseURI for token URI construction.
onlyOwner function that mints 10 giveaway tokens to msg.sender; requires totalSupply()==0.
onlyOwner function that batch-adds addresses to the whitelist while respecting the member cap.
View function asserting an address is whitelisted and below its purchase limit.
onlyOwner function to switch sale state between closed, whitelist and public.
Payable public mint entry point that validates limits, price and sale state, then mints via createToken.
Private minting helper that increments the counter, safe-mints, and records offSetIndexBlock on sell-out.
onlyOwner function that mints remaining tokens to the owner when sales are closed.
Public function deriving offSetIndex from offSetIndexBlock and optionally blockhash, weak randomness.
onlyOwner function that re-sets the offSetIndexBlock when sales are closed.
onlyOwner function that splits contract balance 25/25/25 to Address1-3 and remainder to Address4.
Constructor setting NFT name/symbol, base URI and executing the giveaway mint.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used as mint recipient, owner and whitelist key.
Native ETH transfers via payable(...).transfer to four payout addresses inside withdrawETH.
Offset derived from blockhash(offSetIndexBlock - 1) modulo MAX_MINTED, predictable miner-influenced randomness.
External onERC721Received callback executed by _safeMint/_checkOnERC721Received on token recipients.
Parameter _hash of setProvenance, the new provenance value.
Parameter _value of setBaseURI, the new base URI.
Parameter _addresses of addToWhiteList, the batch of whitelisted addresses.
Parameter _address of checkWhiteList, the address being verified.
Parameter _value of updateSaleState, the requested new sale state.
Parameter _amount of mintToken, number of tokens requested.
Parameter _wallet of createToken, recipient of the minted token.
Parameter _amount of mintUnsoldTokens, number of owner tokens to mint.
Parameter _value of the constructor, initial base URI.
Local wallet variable in mintToken holding _msgSender().
Local _offset variable in generateOffsetIndex holding the derived offset.
Local balance variable in withdrawETH holding the contract balance.
Local amount variable in withdrawETH, balance*25/100 paid to Address1-3.

edges.reason: msg.sender is captured as wallet and used to price, whitelist-check and mint tokens in mintToken.
msg.sender (owner) receives the 10 giveaway tokens minted in mintGiveaway.
msg.sender is the recipient of owner-minted unsold tokens in mintUnsoldTokens.
mintToken calls the private createToken helper inside its mint loops.
mintToken calls checkWhiteList when saleSTATE == 1 to gate whitelist purchases.
createToken increments and reads tokenCounter to derive the minted token id.
createToken writes offSetIndexBlock when the collection reaches MAX_MINTED.
createToken calls _safeMint which invokes the external onERC721Received callback on contract recipients.
withdrawETH performs four native ETH transfers to external payout addresses after balance reads.
generateOffsetIndex derives the offset from blockhash, the weak randomness primitive.
generateOffsetIndex writes the derived value into offSetIndex.
generateOffsetIndex reads offSetIndexBlock as the randomness seed and compares block.number.
updateSaleState, restricted by onlyOwner, writes the saleSTATE gate consumed by minting.
mintToken reads saleSTATE to decide between whitelist, public and closed behaviour.
mintToken reads PRICE to validate msg.value in the public branch.
mintToken reads wlistPRICE to validate msg.value in the whitelist branch.
mintToken reads and increments WHITELIST[wallet].amountPurchased.
mintToken requires _amount + totalSupply() <= MAX_MINTED.
mintToken requires _amount <= PURCHASE_LIMIT in the public branch.
mintToken performs limit arithmetic _amount + WHITELIST[wallet].amountPurchased <= WlistPURSHASE_LIMIT.
addToWhiteList sets WHITELIST[_addresses[i]].exists = true for each address.
addToWhiteList increments WHITELIST_MEMBERCOUNT and checks it against the cap, integer arithmetic.
addToWhiteList requires WHITELIST_MEMBERCOUNT + arrayLength <= WHITELIST_MAXMEMBERS.
checkWhiteList reads WHITELIST[_address].exists and amountPurchased.
checkWhiteList compares amountPurchased against WlistPURSHASE_LIMIT.
setBaseURI writes the BaseURI state variable.
_baseURI returns BaseURI for ERC721 tokenURI construction.
setProvenance, protected by onlyOwner, writes PROVENANCE.
withdrawETH transfers the 25% share to constant Address1.
withdrawETH transfers the 25% share to constant Address2.
withdrawETH transfers the 25% share to constant Address3.
withdrawETH transfers the remaining balance to constant Address4.
mintUnsoldTokens calls createToken in its decrementing loop.
mintGiveaway calls _safeMint which triggers the external onERC721Received receiver callback.
mintGiveaway increments tokenCounter before each _safeMint.
retryOffsetIndexBlock writes block.number into offSetIndexBlock.
mintUnsoldTokens requires saleSTATE == 0 before minting.
mintUnsoldTokens requires _amount + totalSupply() <= MAX_MINTED.
The constructor calls setBaseURI(_value) to initialise metadata.
The constructor calls mintGiveaway() to mint the initial giveaway tokens.
Parameter _hash flows into the PROVENANCE assignment in setProvenance.
Parameter _value flows into the BaseURI assignment in setBaseURI.
Parameter _addresses is iterated to populate WHITELIST in addToWhiteList.
Parameter _address indexes the WHITELIST mapping in checkWhiteList.
Parameter _value is validated (<3) and stored into saleSTATE in updateSaleState.
Parameter _amount drives the price and supply arithmetic and the mint loop in mintToken.
Parameter _wallet is the mint recipient passed to _safeMint in createToken.
Parameter _amount controls the decrementing mint loop and supply check in mintUnsoldTokens.
Constructor parameter _value is forwarded to setBaseURI.
Local wallet in mintToken is assigned _msgSender() and used for whitelist and mint calls.
Local _offset is computed from offSetIndexBlock/blockhash and assigned to offSetIndex.
Local balance in withdrawETH is read from address(this).balance.
Local amount in withdrawETH is computed as balance.mul(25).div(100).
The computed amount is the value sent by the native ETH transfers.
The full remaining balance is transferred to Address4, driving the last ETH transfer.
The onERC721Received receiver callback executes while mintToken/createToken state is only partially updated, allowing re-entrant minting.
Native ETH transfer hands control to the recipient, which may re-enter withdrawETH.

Trivial input parameter fully consumed by the setBaseURI state assignment.
Address array parameter only used to write WHITELIST entries and member count inside addToWhiteList.
Single address parameter used solely to index WHITELIST in checkWhiteList.
Value parameter is validated and stored into saleSTATE by updateSaleState.
Amount parameter drives all supply, price and loop arithmetic inside mintToken.
Wallet parameter is the direct recipient argument of _safeMint in createToken.
Amount parameter drives the decrementing mint loop inside mintUnsoldTokens.
Constructor base URI parameter is only forwarded to setBaseURI.
Temporary holder of _msgSender() local to the mintToken execution context.
Temporary offset computation local to generateOffsetIndex before storing offSetIndex.
Temporary cache of the contract balance inside withdrawETH.
Computed payout amount directly feeds the native ETH transfer unsafe operation.
